description: Browse recent workspace entities across documents, tasks, email, calendars, channels, calls, projects and chats with time, property, tag and inbox filters.
overview: # Class: WorkspaceNamespace Browse recent workspace documents (including tasks), chats, projects, email, channels, message threads, calls, calendar events and foreign entities. Queries run with the caller's normal access permissions. Use search namespaces to find specific names/content; use this namespace for activity and filtered lists. Each item has an existing `entity` handle plus a generated API `snapshot` for reading metadata without another request. Calendar snapshots contain event time and conference details; calendar handles support operations, but cannot fetch event details by ID. Use `snapshot.data` when the listing already has your data. ## Examples **Important emails from a particular accessible inbox** ```js const page = await macro.workspace.page({ emailPreset: 'signal', inbox: 'team@example.com', limit: 20, }); const evidence = page.items.map(item => ({ id: item.id, ...item.type === 'email' ? { subject: item.subject, snippet: item.snippet, sender: item.senderEmail, } : {}, })); // Report page.hasMore; this bounded page is not exhaustive. ``` **Tasks assigned to me, completed and updated within a time window** ```js const owner = await macro.myPrincipalId(); const tasks = macro.workspace.list({ includeTypes: ['document'], df: {'&': [{l: {dst: 'task'}}, {'&': [ {l: {ua: {gte: '2026-10-14T00:00:00Z'}}}, {l: {ua: {lt: '2026-10-15T00:00:00Z'}}}, ]}]}, propf: {'&': [ {l: {pd: '00000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', et: 'TASK', v: {so: '00000001-0000-0000-0002-000000000004'}}}, {l: {pd: '00000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', et: 'TASK', v: {er: owner}}}, ]}, }); for await (const item of tasks) { if (item.type === 'document') console.log(item.id, item.name); } // updatedAt is not a completion timestamp; describe this scope accurately. ``` **Personal and team tags, favorites, and early stopping** ```js let count = 0; for await (const item of macro.workspace.list({ favoritesOnly: true, sortBy: 'recently_viewed', tags: [{label: 'Launch', scope: 'team'}], tagsMatch: 'all', })) { console.log(item.type, item.id, item.tags); if (++count === 10) break; // No subsequent page is fetched. } ``` A single filter is `{l: {dst: 'task'}}`; `&` and `|` require exactly two expressions, nested for larger combinations. Advanced filters use the normal API AST. `df` accepts `dst` (task/skill/snippet), `ft`, `id`, `pid`, and `ca`/`ua` timestamp bounds. `ef` supports `Sender`, `Recipient`, `Read`, `ThreadId`, `ca`/`ua`/`va`; `chanf` supports `ChannelId`, `Sender`, `IsParticipant`; `cthf` supports `ChannelId`/`ThreadId`; `callf` supports `CallId`/`ChannelId`/`Speaker`/`Attended`. Filters remain server-validated. CRM, agent sessions, initiatives and database rows have their own namespaces and are not included in this browsing surface. ## Constructors ### Constructor > **new WorkspaceNamespace**(`client`): `WorkspaceNamespace` #### Parameters | Parameter | Type | | ------ | ------ | | `client` | `MacroClient` | #### Returns `WorkspaceNamespace` ## Methods ### list() > **list**(`options?`): `AsyncGenerator`\<[`WorkspaceItem`](../../types/type-aliases/WorkspaceItem.md)\> Lazy automatic pagination. `limit` is a page size, not a total result limit. Break a `for await` loop to stop; no speculative next page is fetched. Tag/inbox resolution is reused within this iterator. #### Parameters | Parameter | Type | | ------ | ------ | | `options?` | [`WorkspaceListOptions`](../../types/type-aliases/WorkspaceListOptions.md) | #### Returns `AsyncGenerator`\<[`WorkspaceItem`](../../types/type-aliases/WorkspaceItem.md)\> *** ### page() > **page**(`options?`): `Promise`\<[`WorkspacePage`](../../types/type-aliases/WorkspacePage.md)\> One bounded page. Resume using nextCursor and the same options. #### Parameters | Parameter | Type | | ------ | ------ | | `options?` | [`WorkspacePageOptions`](../../types/type-aliases/WorkspacePageOptions.md) | #### Returns `Promise`\<[`WorkspacePage`](../../types/type-aliases/WorkspacePage.md)\> # Type Alias: WorkspaceFilters > **WorkspaceFilters** = `Pick`\<[`ApiEntityFilterAst`](../../../../../generated/storage/types.gen/type-aliases/ApiEntityFilterAst.md), `"df"` \| `"pf"` \| `"cf"` \| `"ef"` \| `"chanf"` \| `"cthf"` \| `"callf"` \| `"fef"` \| `"calf"` \| `"propf"`\> Server-validated AST filters, identical to the normal workspace API. Use `{l: literal}`, `{'&': [left, right]}`, `{'|': [left, right]}` or `{'!': expr}`. `&` and `|` require exactly two expressions; nest them for three or more. A single condition is `{l: literal}` without an `&` wrapper. Each entity filter applies only to that type; `propf` applies across types. See WorkspaceNamespace for task and time-window examples. # Type Alias: WorkspaceItem > **WorkspaceItem** = `Entry`\<`"document"`, `"document"`, [`Document`](../../../documents/document/classes/Document.md)\> & \{ `fileType?`: `string` \| `null`; `name`: `string`; `subType?`: `string` \| `null`; \} \| `Entry`\<`"chat"`, `"ai_chat"`, [`Chat`](../../../chats/chat/classes/Chat.md)\> & \{ `name`: `string`; \} \| `Entry`\<`"project"`, `"project"`, [`Project`](../../../projects/project/classes/Project.md)\> & \{ `name`: `string`; `sender_id`: `string`; `updated_at`: `string`; \} A thread reply shown in preview. ## Properties | Property | Type | Description | | ------ | ------ | ------ | | `attachments` | [`SoupMessageAttachment`](SoupMessageAttachment.md)[] | Attachments on this reply. | | `content` | `string` | Reply content. | | `created_at` | `string` | Creation timestamp. | | `edited_at?` | `string` \| `null` | Edit timestamp. | | `id` | `string` | Reply id. | | `reactions` | [`SoupCountedReaction`](SoupCountedReaction.md)[] | Reactions on this reply. | | `sender` | [`SoupMessageSender`](SoupMessageSender.md) | Structured sender identity. | | `sender_id` | `string` | Sender id. | | `updated_at` | `string` | Update timestamp. | # Class: WorkspaceNamespace Browse recent workspace documents (including tasks), chats, projects, email, channels, message threads, calls, calendar events and foreign entities. Queries run with the caller's normal access permissions. Use search namespaces to find specific names/content; use this namespace for activity and filtered lists. Each item has an existing `entity` handle plus a generated API `snapshot` for reading metadata without another request. Calendar snapshots contain event time and conference details; calendar handles support operations, but cannot fetch event details by ID. Use `snapshot.data` when the listing already has your data. ## Examples **Important emails from a particular accessible inbox** ```js const page = await macro.workspace.page({ emailPreset: 'signal', inbox: 'team@example.com', limit: 20, }); const evidence = page.items.map(item => ({ id: item.id, ...item.type === 'email' ? { subject: item.subject, snippet: item.snippet, sender: item.senderEmail, } : {}, })); // Report page.hasMore; this bounded page is not exhaustive. ``` **Tasks assigned to me, completed and updated within a time window** ```js const owner = await macro.myPrincipalId(); const tasks = macro.workspace.list({ includeTypes: ['document'], df: {'&': [{l: {dst: 'task'}}, {'&': [ {l: {ua: {gte: '2026-10-14T00:00:00Z'}}}, {l: {ua: {lt: '2026-10-15T00:00:00Z'}}}, ]}]}, propf: {'&': [ {l: {pd: '00000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', et: 'TASK', v: {so: '00000001-0000-0000-0002-000000000004'}}}, {l: {pd: '00000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', et: 'TASK', v: {er: owner}}}, ]}, }); for await (const item of tasks) { if (item.type === 'document') console.log(item.id, item.name); } // updatedAt is not a completion timestamp; describe this scope accurately. ``` **Personal and team tags, favorites, and early stopping** ```js let count = 0; for await (const item of macro.workspace.list({ favoritesOnly: true, sortBy: 'recently_viewed', tags: [{label: 'Launch', scope: 'team'}], tagsMatch: 'all', })) { console.log(item.type, item.id, item.tags); if (++count === 10) break; // No subsequent page is fetched. } ``` A single filter is `{l: {dst: 'task'}}`; `&` and `|` require exactly two expressions, nested for larger combinations. Advanced filters use the normal API AST. `df` accepts `dst` (task/skill/snippet), `ft`, `id`, `pid`, and `ca`/`ua` timestamp bounds. `ef` supports `Sender`, `Recipient`, `Read`, `ThreadId`, `ca`/`ua`/`va`; `chanf` supports `ChannelId`, `Sender`, `IsParticipant`; `cthf` supports `ChannelId`/`ThreadId`; `callf` supports `CallId`/`ChannelId`/`Speaker`/`Attended`. Filters remain server-validated. CRM, agent sessions, initiatives and database rows have their own namespaces and are not included in this browsing surface. ## Constructors ### Constructor > **new WorkspaceNamespace**(`client`): `WorkspaceNamespace` #### Parameters | Parameter | Type | | ------ | ------ | | `client` | `MacroClient` | #### Returns `WorkspaceNamespace` ## Methods ### list() > **list**(`options?`): `AsyncGenerator`\<[`WorkspaceItem`](../../types/type-aliases/WorkspaceItem.md)\> Lazy automatic pagination. `limit` is a page size, not a total result limit. Falls back to MACRO_WEBHOOK_SECRET. | | `wsVerify?` | `string` | - | # Type Alias: BotScope > **BotScope** = `"user"` \| `"team"` Access scope for bot-authenticated requests. `user` acts with the requested-as user's access (requires `requestedAs`); `team` acts with the bot's owning team's access (team-owned bots only). # Type Alias: Env > **Env** = `"dev"` \| `"prod"` \| `"local"` # Type Alias: MacroAuth > **MacroAuth** = \{ `apiKey?`: `never`; `token`: [`TokenSource`](TokenSource.md); `type`: `"user"`; \} \| \{ `apiKey`: `string`; `token?`: `never`; `type`: `"user"`; \} \| \{ `scope?`: [`BotScope`](BotScope.md); `token`: [`TokenSource`](TokenSource.md); `type`: `"bot"`; \} How the SDK authenticates with Macro.
